title: Every pricing surface says one thing about Crew and a Space: a Space comes with Crew, and hosting it is free

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19 (project thread: Sweep the whole site end to end): "You can start a free space with a Crew account." Decision card: "Yes, rewrite that test".

detail: The sweep found two stories live at once. The pricing spine (PLAN_STORY), the site description, the Plans and pricing help article, the pricing FAQ ('Do I need Crew to open a Space? No.') and llms-full.txt said Crew is a separate personal membership and a Space is separate from it. The nine /for doors, the pricing grid, the pricing page and llms.txt said a Space comes with Crew, the Oct 22 ruling (ADR-1818), which the creation gate (ADR-810) enforces when the beta ends. The owner ruled for the second on 2026-11-19 and approved rewriting the lib/pricing/plan-story.test.ts pin that required the first. DONE 2026-11-19: PLAN_STORY spine, lines, paid, crewSpace and crew say a Space comes with Crew; the three lines match the home copy canon ('People join free. Host free with Crew. You pay when you start charging.'); the help article and FAQ follow; llms-full reads the lines instead of a typed copy.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
